evidence.excerpt:
Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to
DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not
arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles
is two-to-one, since(c x, cy, w, h, θ)and(cx, cy, h, w, θ+π/2)
denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are
computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space
can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly lo-
calized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the
inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) fil-
ter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes
this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned
Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student
prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the
two encodings inside the matching

Oriented Semi-DETR comprises three components, summarized
in Fig. 1. First, Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards
whichever encoding is closer to the student prediction, at the one-
to-many regression target and at the supervised and pseudo-label de-
noising targets. The selection is a hardarg min, so the target is
always a valid rectangle. Second, a Swap-invariant Reliability Cost
takes the minimum over the two encodings within the matching cost,
so the filter decides on geometry rather than on the encoding the
teacher produced. Third, Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising ad-
vances the start of pseudo-label denoising, ramps its loss weight lin-
early, and scales each query by the teacher scoreqand the encoding
marginm.

Table S10 lists the settings shared by the runs in Table S4.
They use the Semi-DETR-style training pipeline [1]; the
shared entries were not tuned for this work. The only
configuration-specific exception is the pseudo-label DN
schedule, which is reported separately below because the
legacy controls and the complete Oriented Semi-DETR con-
figuration use different start times.
The warm-up length deserves a comment because it de-
cides which Semi-DETR [1] stage the runs are in. Semi-
DETR uses a one-to-many assignment first and switches to
one-to-one after the warm-up. In our protocol, we set the
warm-up to 180k, equal to the total schedule, so every run
stays in the first stage and the one-to-one branch, together
with the cross-view query consistency associated with that
stage, is not activated. This is our controlled experimental
choice, rather than a claim about a universal Semi-DETR

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline gains are measured on the official DOTA-v2.0 test-dev evaluation server against held-out ground truth, independent of the pseudo-label and matching-cost signals used in training.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Official DOTA-v2.0 test-dev server metrics (AP50, AP75, mAP) on held-out ground-truth labels.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Semi-supervised training signal from teacher pseudo boxes, Hungarian matching costs, GMM filtering, and denoising targets, with the proposed swap-aligned selection and swap-invariant cost shaping that signal.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported performance gains over DINO, Semi-DETR, and Sparse Semi-DETR baselines are consistent across label splits and supported by the presented empirical data, especially for stricter IoU thresholds (AP75). The authors are careful to acknowledge where component ablations show mixed results or small margins.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The method is tested on DOTA-v2.0 across multiple partial label splits (10%, 20%, 30%) and a fully labeled split using official test-dev server evaluations. Detailed ablations comprehensively examine the role of each regression target, the denoising schedule, angle distance metrics, and the prevalence of swap events.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline detection results are independently corroborated by standard mAP metrics on held-out test-dev data evaluated via the official DOTA evaluation server.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Official DOTA-v2.0 test-dev benchmark evaluation server metrics (AP50, AP75, mAP) calculated on unseen ground-truth labels.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Semi-supervised training using supervised losses, pseudo-label teacher predictions, Hungarian matching costs, and GMM filtering.

primary.limitations: The authors explicitly disclose limitations, including the restriction to the one-to-many training stage, the lack of a full multi-seed significance study, an unbalanced ablation for the reliability cost alone, and confounding between angle metric shape and scale.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is clearly formulated with exact mathematical expressions for the equivalence group transformations, distance functions, target selections, and GMM cost modifications. Key implementation nuances, such as performing box dimension swaps on unnormalized pixel coordinates, are thoroughly documented.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a conceptually solid, well-motivated, and thoroughly ablated solution to a specific mathematical ambiguity in semi-supervised DETR architectures. It provides balanced empirical results on an established benchmark without overclaiming.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces Oriented Semi-DETR to resolve the two-to-one parameter-to-rectangle ambiguity in semi-supervised detection transformers via swap-aligned target selection, a swap-invariant Hungarian reliability cost, and swap-aware pseudo-label denoising.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a conceptually solid, well-motivated, and thoroughly ablated solution to a specific mathematical ambiguity in semi-supervised DETR architectures. It provides balanced empirical results on an established benchmark without overclaiming.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly disclose limitations, including the restriction to the one-to-many training stage, the lack of a full multi-seed significance study, an unbalanced ablation for the reliability cost alone, and confounding between angle metric shape and scale.
